title: Population Cage Studies Including Four Mitotype
author: Wen Aw
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rqyd5xw

steps.title: Prepare Initial Fly Lines
steps.instruction: Place approximately 210 eggs from each fly line onto instant Drosophila media (Carolina Biological Supply Company, NC, USA) in bottles.

steps.title: Set Up Population Cages
steps.instruction: Place bottles, each containing a different mitotype, into population cages (22 cm x 21 cm x 36 cm) to achieve a density of approximately 850 flies per cage.

steps.title: Homogenize Gut Flora
steps.instruction: Establish a homogeneous gut flora for each generation using male homogenate.

substeps.instruction: Grind four males from each mitotype (raised on instant food unless otherwise stated) in distilled water.
Aliquot 130 µL of the resulting homogenate into each bottle.

steps.title: Release Adult Flies
steps.instruction: On the first day of eclosion, remove plugs from bottles and release flies into population cages for 3 days.

steps.title: Collect Eggs
steps.instruction: Collect eggs from 3-5 day old adult females using specific oviposition resources.

substeps.instruction: Introduce oviposition resources consisting of yeast placed on top of solidified agar-based medium (4% agar and 10% treacle).

steps.title: Sterilize and Plate Eggs
steps.instruction: Surface sterilize collected eggs and distribute them onto diets.

substeps.instruction: Place approximately 200 eggs on each diet.

steps.title: Maintain Generations
steps.instruction: Repeat the protocol for each generation and freeze adult flies following oviposition.

steps.title: Determine Mitotype Frequency
steps.instruction: Determine the frequency of adult females harboring distinct mitotypes via sequencing and allele-specific PCR of 95 individual females from each cage.

steps.title: Extract and Amplify mtDNA
steps.instruction: Extract DNA and amplify a ~900bp region of mtDNA.

steps.title: Analyze Sequences
steps.instruction: Perform Sanger sequencing and analyze the results to determine the proportion of each mitotype per diet and generation.

substeps.instruction: Import chromatograms into Sequencher 4.5 (Gene Codes, MI, USA).
